support_scope: Governance roadmap that prioritizes researcher and enterprise-engineer language surfaces, records conditional/deferred language surfaces, and requires named audience, owner, contract tests, fixtures, examples, release evidence, and no adapter-owned formula logic before future language promotion.

gap_register.gap: The strategy does not itself implement or publish deferred language bindings.
gap_register.rationale: Implementation and publication are owned by the individual binding and registry-submission tracks.

gap_register.gap: Audience and owner evidence for deferred surfaces remains external to this strategy document.
gap_register.rationale: The strategy defines the promotion gate; deferred tracks must satisfy it before moving forward.

description: Prioritize language support around researchers and enterprise engineers, and prevent unsupported language sprawl.
